---
name: grill-with-docs
description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, while creating ADRs and a glossary as decisions and terms are resolved.
---

Use the workflows in [grilling](../grilling/SKILL.md) and [domain-modeling](../domain-modeling/SKILL.md) together. Interview the user in rounds using the design-tree frontier; as terminology is clarified, update the appropriate glossary inline, and offer ADRs only for decisions that meet the domain-modeling criteria. Research repository facts yourself. Do not implement the design until the user confirms the shared understanding.
